g.text: a check enforces it · row kept
The reflector adds a lesson as one row. It never rewrites the table.
The curator reads the active lessons, the constitution and the labeled cases. No regex compares numbers.
The labeled cases measure the curator on every accept. The owner sees the numbers.
A conflict names the clause. The lesson waits as proposed, and main stays green.
The next spec page lists it. The owner decides with gate H1, no extra stop.
A lesson a check enforces leaves the prompt. The row stays, with its lineage.
A false alarm goes back to active. It cost one look, not a red main.
